    assert fibfib(1) == 0
    assert fibfib(2) == 1

    # Recursive cases
    assert fibfib(3) == 1   # 1 + 0 + 0
    assert fibfib(4) == 2   # 1 + 1 + 0
    assert fibfib(5) == 4   # 2 + 1 + 1
    assert fibfib(6) == 7   # 4 + 2 + 1
    assert fibfib(7) == 13  # 7 + 4 + 2
    assert fibfib(8) == 24  # 13 + 7 + 4
    assert fibfib(9) == 44  # 24 + 13 + 7
    assert fibfib(10) == 81 # 44 + 24 + 13


def test_fibfib_larger_values():
    # Sequence: 0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 4, 7, 13, 24, 44, 81, 149, ...
    assert fibfib(11) == 149
    assert fibfib(12) == 274
    assert fibfib(13) == 504
    assert fibfib(14) == 927
    assert fibfib(15) == 1705


def test_fibfib_recurrence_relation():
    # Verify fibfib(n) == fibfib(n-1) + fibfib(n-2) + fibfib(n-3)
    for n in range(3, 12):
        assert fibfib(n) == fibfib(n - 1) + fibfib(n - 2) + fibfib(n - 3)

    expected = [0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 4, 7, 13, 24, 44, 81, 149, 274, 504]
    actual = [fibfib(n) for n in range(14)]
    assert actual == expected

    # All values should be non-negative for valid inputs

        assert fibfib(n) >= 0

    # Base cases
    assert fibfib(0) == 0
    assert fibfib(1) == 0
    assert fibfib(2) == 1

    # Recursive cases
    assert fibfib(3) == 1
    assert fibfib(4) == 2
    assert fibfib(5) == 4
    assert fibfib(6) == 7
    assert fibfib(7) == 13
    assert fibfib(8) == 24
    assert fibfib(9) == 44

    # Verify recurrence relation for a larger value
    n = 12
    assert fibfib(n) == fibfib(n - 1) + fibfib(n - 2) + fibfib(n - 3)

    # Verify expected value computed iteratively
    expected = [0, 0, 1]
    for i in range(3, 15):
        expected.append(expected[i - 1] + expected[i - 2] + expected[i - 3])
    for i in range(15):
        assert fibfib(i) == expected[i]

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_fibfib()
